[2] 00:11 CUSTOMER: Hi Sneha, this is Pooja Menon. I ordered a cotton kurta set last week but the size is too small for me, and I would like to return it and get a refund.
[3] 00:25 AGENT: I would be happy to help with that, Ms. Menon. To verify your identity first, could you please share your Order ID and the last four digits of your registered mobile number?
[4] 00:38 CUSTOMER: Sure, the order ID is ORD-44210 and the last four digits of my phone number are 7186.
[5] 00:45 AGENT: Thank you, that matches our records. Just to confirm that I have understood correctly, you received the cotton kurta set in size M, it does not fit, and you would like to return it for a refund. Is that right?
[6] 01:01 CUSTOMER: Yes, exactly. I should have ordered size L.
[7] 01:05 AGENT: I am sorry for the inconvenience, Ms. Menon, and I will personally make sure this return is arranged smoothly for you. May I ask when the parcel was delivered?
[8] 01:17 CUSTOMER: It was delivered nine days ago.
[9] 01:20 AGENT: Thank you. A kurta set falls under the non-electronics category, which has a return window of 14 calendar days from delivery, so your return is eligible. Is the item unused and with the tags and original packaging intact?

[11] 01:43 AGENT: Perfect. Since the reason is a size issue, I do not need photographs. The order value is Rs 1,299, which is within my approval limit of Rs 5,000, so I can approve the refund right away.
[12] 01:57 CUSTOMER: That is great. How will I get the money back? I paid cash on delivery.
[13] 02:04 AGENT: Since this was a cash on delivery order, our delivery partner cannot hand over cash. The refund will be sent by NEFT bank transfer to your verified bank account, within 5 to 7 business days after the reverse pickup and warehouse verification.
[14] 02:21 CUSTOMER: Okay, that works for me. When will the pickup happen?
[15] 02:25 AGENT: I have booked the reverse pickup, and it will be scheduled within 48 to 72 hours. Your return reference ticket is RTN-55120. Please keep the kurta set in its original packaging with the tags attached for the courier.
[16] 02:41 CUSTOMER: Alright, I will keep it ready.
[17] 02:44 AGENT: To summarise, the return for order ORD-44210 is approved under ticket RTN-55120, pickup within 48 to 72 hours, and a refund of Rs 1,299 by NEFT within 5 to 7 business days after verification. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
[18] 03:01 CUSTOMER: No, that is all. Thank you so much, Sneha.

- GEN-01 | Professional Greeting & Identity Introduction | mandatory
  Required: Greet the customer with high energy, state company name, introduce yourself by name, and inquire how you may assist.
  Good looks like: The agent opens within 2 seconds of call connection with a polite, welcoming tone, introducing both the brand and representative name.
- GEN-02 | Mandatory Call Recording Disclosure | mandatory, CRITICAL
  Required: Provide the required statutory notification informing the customer that the interaction is being recorded for quality and compliance.
  Good looks like: The disclosure is clearly articulated within the first two conversation turns without mumbling or skipping.
- GEN-03 | Caller Identification & Two-Factor Verification | mandatory, CRITICAL
  Required: Authenticate caller identity by requesting Order ID and the last 4 digits of the registered mobile phone number before revealing any account data.
  Good looks like: The agent systematically validates both verification data points before disclosing addresses, order contents, or monetary info.
- GEN-04 | Active Listening & Issue Clarification | mandatory
  Required: Allow the customer to describe their concern without interrupting, then paraphrase the core issue to confirm mutual understanding.
  Good looks like: The agent maintains silence while the customer speaks, takes notes, and summarizes the specific problem back to the customer.
- GEN-05 | Empathy & Ownership Statement | mandatory
  Required: Express sincere empathy for the customer's inconvenience and offer personal reassurance that you will take ownership of the solution.
  Good looks like: Empathetic acknowledgment that avoids robotic stock phrases, validating the customer's frustration.
- GEN-06 | Accurate Policy Explanation & Solution Execution | mandatory, CRITICAL
  Required: State company terms, timelines, and resolutions strictly grounded in verified ShopEase policy documents.
  Good looks like: Explaining exact delivery or refund windows (e.g., 5-7 business days for refund, 7 days for electronics) without making out-of-policy promises.
- GEN-07 | Additional Assistance & Next Steps Summary | mandatory
  Required: Summarize the exact resolution agreed upon, reference ticket numbers, and proactively ask if there are any other questions.
  Good looks like: Clear recap of actions taken, tracking reference shared, and an open invitation for secondary questions.
- GEN-08 | Professional Branded Sign-Off | mandatory
  Required: Conclude the interaction with a warm, professional closing mentioning ShopEase.
  Good looks like: Courteous parting statement thanking the customer, waiting for the customer to disconnect first.
- REF-S1 | Authenticate Order and Customer Identity | mandatory, CRITICAL
  Required: Collect and verify the ShopEase Order ID and the last 4 digits of the registered mobile phone number prior to discussing order or payment details.
  Good looks like: The agent confirms both values in the CRM portal before mentioning what items were purchased or amounts paid.
- REF-S2 | Determine Return Window Eligibility by Category | mandatory, CRITICAL
  Required: Check order delivery date against item category window (7 calendar days for electronics, 14 calendar days for non-electronics).
  Good looks like: The agent explicitly checks the delivery timestamp in the CRM and articulates the applicable category window clearly.
- REF-S3 | Inspect Reason for Return and Evidence | mandatory
  Required: Identify reason for return (damaged, defective, wrong size, or dissatisfied) and request photo proof if damaged/DOA.
  Good looks like: If customer claims damage or wrong product, agent confirms whether it was reported within 48 hours and verifies unboxing photos.
- REF-S4 | Verify Monetary Approval Threshold Limit | mandatory, CRITICAL
  Required: Check if the requested refund or concession amount is within the frontline agent limit of Rs 5,000.
  Good looks like: If the refund is Rs 5,000 or less, the agent approves immediately. If above Rs 5,000, the agent informs the customer that supervisor sign-off is required.
- REF-S5 | Communicate Refund Method and Payment Destination | mandatory, CRITICAL
  Required: Inform customer that refunds return strictly to original payment source, or via NEFT bank transfer for Cash on Delivery (COD) orders.
  Good looks like: Clear communication preventing customer expectation of cash payouts or transfers to unverified third-party wallets.
- REF-S6 | Articulate the 5-7 Business Day SLA Timeline | mandatory
  Required: Clearly state that the refund will process within 5 to 7 business days following reverse pickup and warehouse inspection.
  Good looks like: The agent quotes the exact 5-7 business day timeline without promising unrealistic instant or same-day turnaround.
- REF-S7 | Generate Reverse Pickup and Share Reference Ticket | mandatory
  Required: Book reverse logistics pickup slot, generate service ticket reference, and provide pickup instructions.
